notes:
TCC Website Features 0.5.2: a category name with commas is kept as one category

Typing a series name such as "Faith, Hope, Love" into "+ Add New Category"
on a sermon made three categories, because WordPress splits the name at its
commas. The new feature "Category names keep their commas" keeps the whole
name as one category. Names without a comma and the Parent choice work as
before. Switch it on under TCC Website > Features.

Also records the 50 Years heading, the Divi editor check and the cause of
the stray categories in the open items list.
